name: OI-flush reversal — deleverage bounce gated by ATR expansion (4h)
rationale: MECHANISM: same forced-deleverage thesis as the 1h flush, but read on a 4h clock and confirmed by ATR expansion rather than realized-vol z. A sharp open_interest contraction plus a deeply negative 4h return plus an ATR blow-out (atr as a fraction of price stretched high) marks the moment liquidation engines and de-risking market-makers MUST transact regardless of price. The solo steps in AFTER the cascade to supply the liquidity the leveraged crowd was forced to demand; the 4h clock catches slower, deeper washouts that the 1h version fires inside of. SPOT long, hold ~0.3-0.75d. DISCONFIRMER 1: kill if it does not beat a same-ATR-expansion falling-knife baseline that ignores open_interest — the edge must be the deleverage fingerprint, not generic volatility-buying. DISCONFIRMER 2: kill if the net edge comes from a handful of Oct/Nov-2025 mega-cascades (fails effective-N).
catalyst: 4h OI contraction + deep negative return + ATR expansion — a forced-deleverage washout to fade long.
